description: American Carbon Registry (ACR) projects from its public registry on ICE GreenTrace: search by text or project type (forest carbon, landfill gas, refrigerants, orphaned wells, CCS …); per project the ACR ID, name, status, type, methodology, developer, crediting program, country, credits issued, last status change and registry links, plus the total number of matching projects. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
